name: CDC Data Centres Marsden Park campus
summary: CDC Data Centres is building a campus of six four-storey data center buildings on about 20 hectares in the Marsden Park Industrial Precinct in Sydney's north-west, within the City of Blacktown. CDC turned the first sod in October 2024 and plans 504 MW of ICT capacity, scalable toward 1 GW, with a dedicated substation of about 720 MVA. The NSW government approved it as state significant development on 27 November 2025 despite objections from Blacktown City Council; press coverage put the investment at A$3.1 billion. CDC describes the campus as in the early stages of construction.

location.note: Sources name the Marsden Park Industrial Precinct without a street address; the point is the Marsden Park suburb coordinate from its Wikipedia article, so it marks the suburb rather than the site.
